coverage.note: Detector-axis extents and tangent-plane area; not a north-up rectangular footprint. SIP WCS retained in original FITS.

background.method: Median of all valid pixels; includes sources and diffuse emission. Display diagnostic, not fitted sky or subtracted background.

diagnostics.interpretation: Masked values are not evidence of a dead detector. Finite unflagged values may still include noise or artifacts; no pixel-level astrophysical classification is established.

zodiacal_model.note: Original ZODI model; not subtracted from IMAGE or used as fitted sky.

orientation: Native detector axes; x right, y up. Not north up.
